top_deficiency_types.title: Inspect, test, and maintain automatic sprinkler systems.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Ensure heating and ventilation systems that have been properly installed according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Honor the resident's right to be treated with respect and dignity and to retain and use personal possessions.
Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.
